lines.t: I was crowned in my mind as a little boy king
Built shrines in my chest to the disney love-scene
Wrote vows in the dark, “I will worship her eyes”
Cast women as ashtoreth under soft skies
Tried to mix YAHUWAH with my romance scripts
Put YahuShua on the shelf while I chased her lips
Called it holy, but the altar smelled like flesh and pride
I was pagan Israel with a Bible at my side
I made myself baal, I enthroned my need
Every goddess on a pedestal where You should be
Diagnosed in Your light as a goddess worshipper
All my disney idols crash, every false love shattered sure
You arrive with jealous fire, zeal that burns but doesn’t harm
Smash the scripts that never saved me, pull me safely to Your arms
Show me One True Man, YahuShua in full view
Every cope disintegrates, there is no man but You
Yeah…
Mixed worship, double heart, split throne
YAHUWAH in my mouth, but romance on the stone
Soul tattooed by the world’s coming-of-age scenes
Chasing happily-ever-after in these cheap dream streams
Life hits, idols crack, now I’m found wanting
Lament on repeat, “All is vain, I’m haunted”
So I numb, drown conviction, rationalize the ache
Trying harder to uphold what You came to break
Then You step in fierce, not a whisper but a storm
Zealous love overturning every altar I’d formed
You replay every script where I made woman god
Where YahuShua was accessory to my façade
You hammer down the lie that romance makes me whole
You tear out ashtoreth from the marrow of my soul
Yet in the ruins of the boy I thought I had to be
I feel a love I’ve never known burning over me
You say, “Look, this is Man” and You show me the Lamb
Wounded, pure, undefiled, the I AM that I AM
Adam’s fall of worshiping eve reversed in light
The curse snaps off when I see You right
No more goddess on the throne, no more baal in my chest
False-fulfillment scripts erased, I’m invited into rest
Every lesser masculinity fades from view
New life left standing with One Name: YahuShua, You
Diagnosed in Your light as a goddess worshipper
All my disney idols crash, every false love shattered sure
You arrive with jealous fire, zeal that burns but doesn’t harm
Smash the scripts that never saved me, pull me safely to Your arms
Show me what a Man is – only You, forever true
All my coping falls away, there is no man but You
Empty-handed, idol-bare, but I’m finally home
In the foreign love of YahuShua, flesh of all my bones
